character.appendages: Four minute ground contacts, two attached triangular head points and one long flexible tail. No arms, wings, detached ornaments or additional tails may be introduced; contact endpoints and tail direction follow each donor cell.
character.contactAndOrigin: Native canvas 64x64, source origin [24,44], union [-16,-28,32,4]. Preserve the shared origin: low bodies contact near y=44-48, while tail/rightward extension reaches +32 relative X; do not bbox-recenter or per-cell autofit.
character.faceAndExpression: The visible leading eye, brow/ear angle and red mouth change by pose. Mouth-open effort/alarm is clear in the frontal/upright cells; rear, curled and flattened cells intentionally occlude much of the face.
character.locomotion: Source cells show low crawl/run rocking, horizontal stretch and compression, diagonal pivot, short airborne/tail-led lifts, upright rear, curl, slide and fully collapsed poses. Preserve raw sequence IDs because action names are not proven.
character.morphology: Low elongated four-contact juvenile creature with a compact gray face, two tall attached triangular head points, a blue underside and a long tapering blue tail; it stays quadrupedal/ground-hugging except for source-authored lifts and rears.
character.restraint: Main 027-043 is the complete restrained block. A gold/dark external binding crosses or wraps the body in low, diagonal, upright, open-mouth and flattened poses; every canonical restrained master and all aliases must retain readable binding.
character.specialStates: Main 044/046 are orange-red color states, 047 upright black silhouette, 048 low black silhouette, 061 stone-gray, and 064 white evolution silhouette. Main 045 and 049-060/062-063 are distinct normal-palette/defeated motion cells, not generic recolors.
